student_message_function.description: What kind of message this was in context: content, procedure/meta, off-task, answer, question, request for answer, disagreement, etc.

what_the_student_did_with_the_idea.description: How the student engaged the idea: used it, explained it, repeated it, avoided it, or similar.

independence_of_evidence.description: How much of the student's performance was their own reasoning versus following tutor support.

evidence_strength.description: Per-turn overall strength of evidence actually shown in the student's message.

response_alignment.description: Whether and how the student's message responded to what was asked, including when it productively went elsewhere.

error_status.description: Whether the issue was a real misunderstanding, a skipped step, neither, or unclear.

student_state.description: Brief reading of how the student seems to be doing: engaged, impatient, tired, lost, frustrated, etc.

route_or_direction.description: Route or local direction being followed on this turn.

current_stop.description: Current stop or local conceptual position.

student_steered.description: Whether the student determined the direction of this turn.

interaction_mode.description: Primary interaction mode used on this turn.

next_move.description: What move the tutor chose to make next in this turn.

why_this_move.description: Why that move was chosen, in light of the student's message, route logic, time, and priorities.

help_level.description: How much help the tutor gave.

why_this_help_level.description: Why this amount of help was appropriate.

notes.description: Brief note if any self-check item needed attention.
